plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a piece of land in Utah's Uinta Basin known for strange happenings, named after skinwalkers, shape-shifting beings from Native American lore. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the legend is that the Ute tribe, who worked with the US government, fought the Navajo, and the unhappy Navajo cursed the spot with skinwalkers. In a later telling he leaves out the Navajo and says the Ute call it cursed ground and will not talk about it, adding that drones, helicopters and equipment fail there.
